mapper.select: select coalesce(view_count, 0) from article_views where article_id = #{articleId} union all select 0 limit 1
select count(1) from article_favorites where article_id = #{articleId}
select count(1) from comments where article_id = #{articleId}
select A.id from articles A left join article_favorites AF on A.id = AF.article_id where A.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') group by A.id order by count(AF.user_id) desc limit #{limit}
